posts.cooked:
I agree with what's been touched on by others in this thread. The '11 or 7' comment, I feel, is related to the villains proper. My take is that there are five villain decks: The Vengeance Five. These guys can function as individual villains, or one mega group of destruction, like the Ennead, but with individual mechanics due to each member having their own deck of cards instead of being referred to constantly as "the villain target with the highest HP attacks", etc. Also, it would add a ton of flavour to the fight. I imagine Tachynot (love that name, by the way) would be flying about the battlefield doing her sabotage that she does best, just like our beloved Tachyon does with her own deck. And, the chaos can only grow as the other members do their own thing as well!

 

That leaves leaves 6 decks, and I would generally consider four new heroes and two environments, just for the chance of choice with environments. However, the game is a five-player game, potentially, so there is a clear argument for five heroes and only one environment. I just wonder if pre-established villains can team up together or if it is an exclusive Vengeance Five thing...this is, of course, assuming that my hypothesis is anywhere near the mark in the first place.

 

Let me also just say: this KickStarter has been the best ever. Just about every turn has been something I didn't expect at all, or something that played so closely to my expectations, but far better, such as Visionary. We all thought her nemesis would be herself, but the first reveal was Dark Visionary promo hero card! But, her nemesis is still herself, just not how I originally thought it would be. Great twists, the lot of 'em!
